description: A photo has been in the trash longer than the retention period. Describe everything that happens to it, its stack, its live-photo partner and its files on disk, and what schedules this.
anchor_note: non-bug task: root_cause_symbols holds the anchor (entry point / changed symbol); RC metrics are reported for category A only
alternatives: The same handleAssetDeletion path is entered by TrashService.handleEmptyTrash (user empties trash) and LibraryService offline-asset deletion with deleteOnDisk false.

source.verification: server/src/services/asset.service.spec.ts describe 'handleAssetDeletion' (line 574): tests 'should clean up files', 'should delete the stack when a non-primary asset is deleted and only the primary would remain', 'should keep the stack when a non-primary asset is deleted and the primary plus another asset remain', 'should not delete a live motion part if it is being used by another asset', 'should update usage'. Medium test: server/test/medium/specs/services/asset.service.spec.ts.
source.notes: handleAssetDeletion enqueues FileDelete rather than unlinking directly; the actual file removal happens in a different job/handler (StorageService.handleDeleteFiles). Trash retention is config.trash.days (asset.service.ts:282).

evidence: server/src/services/asset.service.ts:280-297 handleAssetDeletionCheck; :302-371 handleAssetDeletion (stack :314-334, remove :336, usage :~337-339, emit AssetDelete :341, motion :344-352, FileDelete :369)

notes: Verified: handleNightlyJobs queues AssetDeleteCheck only when nightlyTasks.databaseCleanup (queue.service.ts:268-276) -> handleAssetDeletionCheck (asset.service.ts:279-297: trash days, 0 if trash disabled) -> AssetDelete -> handleAssetDeletion (:301-371: stack dissolve/promote, AssetRepository.remove, UserRepository.updateUsage only without libraryId, AssetDelete emit, motion asset re-queued if unused, FileDelete) -> StorageService.handleDeleteFiles (storage.service.ts:120-133).
